summary.value: 北洋政府軍人政治家。1916年4月受任國務總理兼陸軍總長，同年6月再任國務總理，1917年5月23日被免職；1917年7月張勳復辟期間受命為國務總理兼總司令；1924年11月24日就任臨時執政，1926年4月下野。

body.zh-Hant: 1916年4月，袁世凱政府宣布改行責任內閣，任命段祺瑞為國務總理兼陸軍總長。同年6月29日夜，總統發布命令恢復國會、沿用南京臨時約法，段祺瑞再獲任命為國務總理。1917年5月23日段祺瑞被免去總理職務，其後北方多省宣布獨立。
body.en: In April 1916 a mandate establishing a responsible cabinet appointed Tuan Chi-jui (Duan Qirui) Premier and Minister of War. On the night of 29 June 1916 the President issued mandates reconvening Parliament and Tuan was reappointed Premier. He was dismissed as Premier on 23 May 1917, after which several northern provinces seceded.

body.zh-Hant: 1917年7月張勳擁清復辟，段祺瑞時為無兵權的平民，赴馬廠第八師號召反對復辟。總統黎元洪避入使館區前發布命令，任命段祺瑞為國務總理兼總司令。同年11月16日段祺瑞與全體閣員辭職，翌日經與總統會商後撤回辭呈。
body.en: During Chang Hsun's monarchist restoration of July 1917, Tuan, then a private citizen without command, rallied the 8th Division at Machang. Before taking refuge in the Legation Quarter on 2 July, President Li Yuan-hung issued a mandate appointing Tuan Premier and Commander-in-Chief. On 16 November 1917 Tuan and his whole cabinet resigned; the resignations were withdrawn the next day.

citations.quote: he was at that time actually only a private citizen without authority or command

at the end of which the resignations were withdrawn

body.zh-Hant: 1924年11月，張作霖、馮玉祥等通電擁段祺瑞為臨時執政；外交部告知內閣將把總理與總統職權交給段祺瑞。11月24日上午段祺瑞就任「中華民國執政」。1926年4月國民軍發動政變，段祺瑞一度遭軟禁、避入使館區，4月20日前後離京下野，其臨時政府為張作霖、吳佩孚聯軍所推翻。
body.en: In November 1924 Chang Tso-lin, Feng Yu-hsiang and their followers called on the provinces to support Tuan as Provisional Chief Executive, and the cabinet was to hand over to him the powers of Premier and President. He assumed office as Chief Executive on the morning of 24 November 1924. In April 1926 a coup placed him under restraint; he left Peking around 20 April, and his Provisional Government was overthrown by the allied forces of Chang Tso-lin and Wu Pei-fu.

body.zh-Hant: 費薩爾為麥加埃米爾暨大謝里夫侯賽因·本·阿里之子，阿拉伯文名「فيصل」，西文文獻亦作 Faisal、Feisal、Fayṣal al-Awwal。
body.en: Faysal (Faisal, Feisal) I was a son of Ḥusayn ibn ʻAlī, amīr and grand sharīf of Mecca.

heading.en: King of Syria and of Iraq

body.zh-Hant: 費薩爾於 1918–1920 年為敘利亞國王，其後於 1921–1933 年為伊拉克國王。英國政府 1921 年底致美方備忘錄提及「費薩爾國王加冕及阿拉伯內閣之任命」。1933年9月8日去世。
body.en: He was King of Syria from 1918 to 1920 and later King of Iraq from 1921 to 1933. A British memorandum of December 1921 referred to the coronation of King Feisal and the appointment of the Arab cabinet in Mesopotamia. He died on 8 September 1933.

body.zh-Hant: 英國未將美索不達米亞委任統治書提交國際聯盟，而以與費薩爾國王締結的條約取代，條約載入委任統治的主要條款。相關文件包括 1922 年 10 月 10 日英伊同盟條約及 1926 年 1 月 13 日英伊條約；英國敕令書將後者題為「伊拉克：與費薩爾國王之條約」。
body.en: Instead of submitting the mandate for Mesopotamia to the League of Nations, Britain concluded a treaty with King Feisal embodying the essential provisions of the mandate. The instruments include the Anglo-Iraq Treaty of Alliance of 10 October 1922 and the Anglo-Iraq Treaty of 13 January 1926, printed in Cmd. 2587 as 'Iraq, Treaty with King Feisal'.
